scope_review: Process design, evidence and hypothetical thresholds are practice; all explicit SEC/PCAOB and IFRS-period anchors are registered separately. No universal SOX regime or accounting-framework control cadence is manufactured.

accuracy_checks.challenge: 20,000 detected against 500,000 materiality is 4%, but 4m exposed activity is not capped at that error. A 20m suspense population unreviewed for three months can conceal gross errors beyond two 30k cleared items; missing review and deficient compensation require likelihood/magnitude/aggregation analysis.
accuracy_checks.reason: Control population, precision, timeliness, evidence and exception route catch the injected failure; legal/auditor classification remains scoped.

claim_checks.challenge: Non-US voluntary readiness is not mandatory SOX; filer and attestation exemptions are separate case inputs.
Do not equate 4% discovered error with maximum possible exposure.
CFO high-level P&L review does not establish balance-sheet reconciliation compensation.
Indicators demand evaluation; no mechanical universal classification from a low amount.
US definitions do not become statutory non-US labels automatically.

period_and_scope_check: 2026 guidance with future December 2026 PCAOB version gate and IFRS 18 early/2027 adoption gate where relevant; local-law, filer, attestation and engagement status independently required.
cross_framework_check: Controls support accounting assertions without treating IFRS/US/UK/Australian recognition as interchangeable; management versus auditor and voluntary versus mandated ICFR reviewed.
numerical_reperformance: 20,000 detected against 500,000 materiality is 4%, but 4m exposed activity is not capped at that error. A 20m suspense population unreviewed for three months can conceal gross errors beyond two 30k cleared items; missing review and deficient compensation require likelihood/magnitude/aggregation analysis.
cross_topic_check: Consistent with approved 02-002/004/005/010 reviewer independence, complete/gross populations and no backdating. Domain 03 supplies actual revenue accounting; Domain 11 supplies data/query/access execution.
rights_check: No standard body or restricted attachment added.
